SOUL Q&A exposes `soul_ask` (persona-only), `soul_qdcvr_ask` (retrieve-then-persona with PAS score), and `soul_router` (auto-routing). Experience meditation spawns an agent harness (`omp -p`/`claude -p`) as a subprocess; the backend only records runs. A circuit breaker trips after 3 consecutive failures (24 h cooldown); unavailable harnesses degrade to mechanical extraction (`confidence=0.3`); auto-extracted, unvetted experiences stay drafts, capped at P1. Signals live in `storage/meditation.db` (SQLite/WAL).

Vector indexing (L4): one KB → one collection (`kb_{kb_id}`), one doc → N chunks (`{doc_path}__chunk_{index}`), BGE-M3 embeddings (1024-dim), `chunk_size=500`, `chunk_overlap=50`, `score_threshold=0.35`. Missing ChromaDB falls back to BM25. Knowledge graph (L5) uses Neo4j with `graph_doc_id` keys and `transformers` NER; optional via `ragctl up --no-neo4j`. Testing splits hermetic unit tests from MinerU integration; `validate_skills.cjs` runs 8 cross-skill checks.
